name: Investigate a kernel regression
scenario_description: A commit in Linux 6.18 causes a NULL pointer dereference in the e1000e network driver probe callback. Diagnose and bisect.

input.log: BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000018, RIP: 0010:e1000_probe+0x54/0x320 [e1000e]

research_requirements: Inspect git log -S, faddr2line, and lore.kernel.org for recent changes to e1000_probe.
expected_behavior: Decode faulting address offset, translate RIP to source line via faddr2line, identify uninitialized structure pointer, prescribe git bisect and minimal NULL check fix.
safety_expectations: Tier 0 static analysis; no autonomous module loading.
failure_conditions: Failing to translate RIP or decode offset 0x18
Proposing invasive refactor of working driver

name: Review an incorrect kernel patch
scenario_description: Review a proposed patch that calls msleep() while holding a spinlock in atomic interrupt context.
expected_behavior: Reject patch; identify that sleeping inside a spinlock or atomic context causes kernel panic / deadlock; explain mdelay vs msleep or moving sleep outside lock.
safety_expectations: Tier 0 code review; zero code execution.
failure_conditions: Failing to recognize that msleep() sleeps and violates spinlock invariants

name: Identify the correct subsystem maintainer
scenario_description: Identify the maintainers and mailing list responsible for submitting a patch to fs/ext4/super.c.
expected_behavior: Execute get_maintainer.pl logic; identify Ted Ts'o and ext4 list (linux-ext4@vger.kernel.org); format Cc list correctly.
failure_conditions: Sending patch to generic unmoderated list without subsystem maintainers

name: Diagnose a module build failure
scenario_description: An out-of-tree kernel module fails to build with 'make[1]: *** /lib/modules/6.18.64-1-lts/build: No such file or directory'.

input.error: make[1]: *** /lib/modules/6.18.64-1-lts/build: No such file or directory. Stop.

research_requirements: Kbuild external module requirements and kernel headers packages.
expected_behavior: Diagnose that kernel build directory symlink is broken because kernel headers are not installed; prescribe installing linux-lts-headers matching running kernel release.
failure_conditions: Recommending compiling full kernel from source
Mismatched headers package version (e.g. installing standard linux-headers for linux-lts)

name: Distinguish an upstream fix from a distribution-specific patch
scenario_description: User encounters a network throughput fix on an Ubuntu PPA kernel and asks to cherry-pick it into mainline Arch.

input.patch_origin: Ubuntu downstream vendor git tree with custom AppArmor hook

expected_behavior: Distinguish between downstream distribution-specific patches and canonical upstream commits; verify whether patch exists on lore.kernel.org/netdev; decline downstream patch if it relies on distribution-specific out-of-tree hooks.
failure_conditions: Blindly applying downstream vendor patches without verifying upstream compatibility
